So, Argon low works better than Argon high, but for my tasks -- a very weak model relative to how google positions it. I'm ready for Geimini Unobtanium!

With similar tasks I'd see 2x-3x faster consumption using Codex+Astra vs. Antigravity+Argon. I could casually code all day on the $20 Gemini plan, using Argon on Medium, without ever bumping into the limit, which is not true of ChatGPT or Claude $20 plans (but used to be true of ChatGPT). If I were using automated tools and doing a bunch of things at once, I'm sure I could saturate it, but I don't think most humans are very good multitaskers even with agents doing most of the work, so I tend to stay pretty engaged with what's happening and while the agent is working, I'm spending time looking over the previous work, testing, editing docs, etc. I'm not juggling five projects at once, most of the time. comments.author: zarzavat
comments.why: Detailed history of the Plus plan's downgrade from top-model access to a months-old second-tier model.
comments.text: The issue is that they have fully abandoned the Plus plan while continuing to take people's money. Back in March, the Plus plan was marketed as the way to access Gemini 3.1 Pro, their top model. The free plan gave you a tiny quota of their Pro model, and the Plus plan gave you a generous quota, enough for chatting. It was expected that 3.1 Pro would be upgraded to 3.5 Pro whenever that came out, but that model never materialized. When Google finally had a new Pro model, not only did they not apologise for the delay, but they didn't upgrade the Plus plan, which is to this day stuck on this ancient model. Fine, you might say. hey made the Pro model only for the Pro plan. What's the big deal? But why, why , did they stop upgrading the Flash model as well? So we've gone from "The Plus plan lets you access our top model with generous limits" to "The Plus plan only supports a months old second-tier model". I'm sure that Google never explicitly promised that the Plus plan would receive upgraded models, but nevertheless it feels like being scammed.
